title: Hoshino Ichika — For The Perfect Sound〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
I need to change out the strings on my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have practice tomorrow, so I should probably do that now before I go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm pretty sure I put those packs in this drawer... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right... I ran out last time.
That means I need to go buy more tomorrow...
The next day
Instrument Shop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm always staggered by all the different strings they have available...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... The ones I always buy are... Oh, here they are. I should probably buy a few packs just in case.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...
Oh, hey...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Iori!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you, Ichika.
Fancy seeing you here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, what a nice surprise.
Are you also here to do some shopping?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm here to buy some strings too.
They should be right around... Aha, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Why is it that no matter how many extra strings you have, you never seem to have enough?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean!
I just noticed that I ran out yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, it happens to the best of us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Initially, I only changed them every one or two months... But I realize now that I need to keep my guitar in the best condition possible if I'm going to continue down this path.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I know.
It's hard not to want to do that when your band's goal is to make it big.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Ichika, your band's signed to a label now, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, we are.
But we haven't actually done anything as pros yet.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Right.
A lot does need to be discussed before you can debut.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We went into the office the other day, and to help decide our marketing strategy, we were asked a question: “What aspirations do you hold for your music?”

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Aspirations for your music...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You seem to have a good manager if they're giving you time to find answers to that sort of question.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, I've heard rumors that some managers just make you do everything they say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm glad to hear your label isn't like that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Once they've figured out a marketing strategy for your band, next will probably be your publicity photos or your debut single.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So, Ichika, I have to think you're pretty excited about the future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I am really excited...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, the more time passes, the more I feel worried about what's gonna happen after we go pro.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
There's just so much to think about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Iori, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm betting my life on music, so it was hard for my brain not to worry.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But I've got it now.
Regardless of where you are, what matters most doesn't change.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: My goal is still to put on good performances and give the crowd the best music I can.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So, as professional musicians, let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's. Thank you for saying that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Also, feel free to ask me for help if you ever think you need it. As a fellow pro with a bit more experience, I'll teach you whatever I can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, does this make you my senior now...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I like your thinking, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It's great to have a junior as cute as you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: By the way, Ichika, what are you doing after this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to go to practice in a little bit, but...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Then, mind hanging out for a bit until then? I kinda want to try some of these instruments.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It's always easier to distinguish what's good and bad about an instrument when you have a reliable session partner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, sure... That sounds great.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Then, let's see if we can borrow that space over there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
